title: Sage viewmodel record
description: A viewmodel record (ViewmodelRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another viewmodel record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

model.description: The arms: a skinned .glb (JOINTS_0, WEIGHTS_0) in view space, looking down -Z. A mesh path. (AssetPath)

graph.description: The anim_graph that animates the arms (idle, attack, reload…); empty = they stand in their rest pose. Names a anim_graph record. (RecordId)

material.description: The arms' material; empty = sage:lit_default (its effect has the Skinned technique) Names a material record. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

weapon.description: What the arms hold: a .glb on `socket`; empty = bare hands. A mesh path. Category: Weapon. (AssetPath)

weaponMaterial.description: The weapon's material; empty = sage:lit_default. Names a material record. Category: Weapon. (RecordRef<MaterialRecord>)

socket.description: A socket of the arms' model (skeleton_sockets) the weapon hangs from. Category: Weapon. (string, default "")

offset.description: Where the arms' origin sits from the eye: x right, y up, z back. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

angles.description: How the arms are turned in view space: pitch, yaw, roll. Unit: deg. (Vector3, default [0,0,0])

replace.description: true (in a patch): replace this object with what the patch writes, instead of merging into it.
